title: Heisler et al. (2010) PLoS Biol. PIN1 polarity / cortical microtubule co-alignment and Louveaux et al. (2016) PNAS stress-oriented division planes — reference thresholds for the Pass 3 L1 cellular vertex-mesh model (Slot 036)

primary_sources.citation: Heisler MG, Hamant O, Krupinski P, Uyttewaal M, Ohno C, Jönsson H, Traas J, Meyerowitz EM (2010) PLoS Biology 8(10):e1000516
primary_sources.role: Live imaging of PIN1-GFP and microtubule reporters in the Arabidopsis shoot apical meristem showing that PIN1 polarity correlates with cortical microtubule orientation (PIN1-rich membranes lie parallel to the CMT array), that both reorient after single-cell laser ablation (CMTs circumferential, PIN1 polarity directed away from the wound) and after compression, and that the PIN1 response to ablation persists after oryzalin microtubule depolymerisation; proposes that PIN1 accumulates on the plasma membrane adjacent to the most stressed anticlinal wall

primary_sources.citation: Louveaux M, Julien J-D, Mirabet V, Boudaoud A, Hamant O (2016) Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 113(30):E4294-E4303
primary_sources.role: Shows that shoot apical meristem cells, in particular at the organ-meristem boundary, orient their division plane along the direction of maximal tensile stress (parallel to the CMT array / preprophase band), deviating from the Errera shortest-wall rule when stress is anisotropic

primary_sources.citation: Hamant O, Traas J (2010) New Phytologist 185(2):369-385
primary_sources.role: Review establishing that plant cells are cemented by the middle lamella and do not undergo neighbour exchange (T1 transitions); topological change in plant tissues arises only from cell division

vertex_mesh_model_parameters.boundary_coupling: affine pre-strain of the patch boundary epsilon_i = sigma_i / E_shell from the zone shell stress tensor (sigma_1, sigma_2)
vertex_mesh_model_parameters.wall_model: Hookean anticlinal wall tension T_e = k_e * max(0, l_e / l0_e - 1) with Lockhart creep of rest length l0_e above yield strain

reference_thresholds.description: <cos^2> of the angle between the PIN1-rich wall axis and the CMT director; PIN1-labelled membranes run parallel to the CMT array (within 30 deg => cos^2 >= 0.75)
Fraction of wound-ring cells whose PIN1 polarity vector points away from the ablated cell
reference_thresholds.source: Heisler et al. (2010) Fig. 4 (ablation) and Fig. 6 (persists under oryzalin)

reference_thresholds.description: <cos^2> of the angle between the CMT director and the circumferential direction around the ablated cell
reference_thresholds.source: Hamant et al. (2008) Fig. 3; Heisler et al. (2010) Fig. 4

reference_thresholds.description: <cos^2> of the angle between new division walls and the local maximal tensile stress axis in the organ-meristem boundary (aligned within 30 deg => cos^2 >= 0.75)
|chi_after - chi_before| summed over all division (and T1) events on the vertex mesh; chi = V - E + F
Number of T1 neighbour exchanges applied in the default plant-tissue run (walls cemented by the middle lamella)
